title: Quitting winnable contests? The calibration of resignation in online chess and surrender in League of Legends: preregistration, code, and pilot summaries
description: Preregistration (v1.0, registered 2026-11-15), pilot scripts, the confirmatory League of Legends collector, and aggregate pilot outputs for a study of how much winning chance players give up when they resign (online chess, Lichess) or surrender (League of Legends). Registered after a pilot and before any confirmatory data were downloaded. Raw Riot API data are not included.
